messages:
maya: Quick repro note — Kotlin suspend helper + multipart upload doesn't retry after auth refresh (401). Java callback path retries fine. Repro in sampleapp on Pixel 6 API 33.

jorge: Can you share Retrofit/OkHttp versions and a stack?

maya: Retrofit 2.9, OkHttp 4.11.0. Stack shows `java.io.IOException: sink closed` from RequestBody.writeTo after a 401, then `okhttp3.internal.http2.StreamAllocation.streamFailed`.

li: Likely one-shot RequestBody + Call reuse. If adapter reuses the same Call instance the body is already consumed on replay. Java path probably clones the Call.

rita: Short-term workaround: wrap RequestBody to be repeatable (buffer or temp-file). Example quick util in Kotlin: ```kotlin
fun repeatable(body: RequestBody): RequestBody { val cache = Buffer().apply { body.writeTo(this) }; return object: RequestBody(){ override fun contentType() = body.contentType(); override fun contentLength() = cache.size; override fun writeTo(sink: BufferedSink){ sink.writeAll(cache.clone()) } } }
``` Expensive but validates the issue.

jorge: Proposed SDK fixes: 1) change suspend adapter to `call.clone()` on each execution attempt, 2) add a WARN when a non-repeatable body is detected (link to docs), 3) provide an opt-in TempFileBackedRepeatableRequestBody for large uploads.

maya: Filed ticket INF-20246 with repro + device logs. Adding a short note in onboarding docs: "Kotlin suspend upload helper may not retry one-shot bodies during auth refresh; use workaround or callback path."

ci-bot: ci: created PR #4201 for suspend-adapter clone + warning. Unit tests passed :white_check_mark:, instrumented upload test flaky on API 33 :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

li: I'll take the temp-file util PR. @jorge can you add the warning link and tests that simulate mid-stream 401 across API 29/33?

rita: Thanks team — moving this to backlog for a proper fix and e2e coverage.
